subject: math
topicName: Trigonometry - Lesson 8: Bearings and Triangle Diagrams
description: Translate bearing descriptions into clear oblique triangle diagrams by drawing north lines, marking clockwise bearings, and placing included angles correctly.
learningObjectives: Draw a local north line before measuring a bearing
Interpret three-digit bearings as clockwise turns from north
Translate one-leg and two-leg navigation statements into labeled triangle diagrams
Identify where the included angle belongs in a bearing diagram
Check whether a route diagram has correct orientation, labels, and angle placement
